name: Pact-Blade
resourceDesc: Vital-Aether, a pool of a hundred: the heat in an Iron-Born's blood, built by your cuts (never by a plain swing) and spent on the aether-cuts. It starts a fight at nothing and drains after. Above 80 it burns: your cuts land harder and you lose a little health each second.
identity: Two swords and the heat of the blood: the Iron Pact's sword-work. CANON-EXPANDED: Veyra's Vital-Aether, 'the incredibly hot spark ... that every Iron-Born fiercely carried in their blood' (book 1 ch. 4), her whirl of white light and gold afterimages (book 1 ch. 10), the world bible's dual-sword master and Talira Frostveil, sword master; the Iron Citadel, the Pact's training ground. Pure damage in heavy armour; no healing, no oaths. No machines.

branches.name: Twin-Blade
branches.loop: Measured Cut and Second Blade for Vital-Aether, Afterimage on cooldown, and Aether Edge when the blood runs hot.
branches.tradeoff: One foe at a time; a pack is cut down one throat at a time.

nodes.name: Aether Edge
nodes.desc: Learn Aether Edge: a cut that spends all your Vital-Aether (30 at least); the more spent, the harder.

nodes.name: Keen Pair
nodes.desc: Measured Cut, Second Blade and Aether Edge deal 3% more per rank.

nodes.name: Quick Blood
nodes.desc: Measured Cut builds 2 more Vital-Aether per rank.

nodes.name: Afterimage
nodes.desc: Learn Afterimage: a cut whose gold afterimage strikes the foe again 2 seconds later.

nodes.name: Bright Wake
nodes.desc: The afterimage strikes for a tenth more of the cut per rank.

nodes.name: Blood-Vow
nodes.desc: Learn the Blood-Vow: for 12 seconds your cuts land harder, and your blood burns you a little each second.

nodes.name: Hot Blood
nodes.desc: Burning Blood (above 80 Vital-Aether) makes your cuts 3% harder again per rank.

nodes.name: Measured to the End
nodes.desc: Aether Edge spent at 80 Vital-Aether or more gives 20 back.

nodes.name: The Redclaw Codex
nodes.desc: Your cuts on a foe under 35% health deal 3% more per rank.

nodes.name: No Wasted Motion
nodes.desc: Second Blade is ready 2 seconds sooner.

nodes.name: The Twin Vow
nodes.desc: Second Blade leaves a gold afterimage too, striking again for 40% of it.

branches.name: White Whirl
branches.loop: Build Vital-Aether, then turn the White Whirl through the pack; Afterglow under them and Turning Steel for the long fights.
branches.tradeoff: Strong against many, ordinary against one.

nodes.name: White Whirl
nodes.desc: Learn the White Whirl: both swords turned in a ring of white light, cutting every foe within 5 metres.

nodes.name: Wide Turn
nodes.desc: The White Whirl deals 3% more per rank.

nodes.name: Long Reach
nodes.desc: The White Whirl reaches half a metre further per rank.

nodes.name: Afterglow
nodes.desc: Learn Afterglow: gold light left on the ground round you for 6 seconds burns the foes in it every second.

nodes.name: Lingering Gold
nodes.desc: Afterglow lasts a second longer per rank.

nodes.name: Turning Steel
nodes.desc: Learn Turning Steel: for 8 seconds Measured Cut and Second Blade also cut two more foes near the target.

nodes.name: Blinding Turn
nodes.desc: The White Whirl slows the foes it cuts by a tenth per rank for 3 seconds.

nodes.name: White Light
nodes.desc: Each foe the White Whirl cuts gives you 3 Vital-Aether.

nodes.name: Long Turn
nodes.desc: Turning Steel lasts a second longer per rank.

nodes.name: Steady Feet
nodes.desc: While Turning Steel lasts you take 5% less.

nodes.name: Ring of Gold
nodes.desc: The White Whirl leaves an Afterglow of its own, once every 12 seconds.

branches.name: Sentinel
branches.loop: Stop what runs, answer what strikes, ring the pack in iron and kick the casts.
branches.tradeoff: Its worth is holds and lighter blows, not the meter.

nodes.name: Answering Cut
nodes.desc: Learn the Answering Cut: within 4 seconds of a blow on you, a cut back that slows the foe.

nodes.name: Watchful
nodes.desc: The Answering Cut deals 3% more per rank.

nodes.name: Long Stop
nodes.desc: Sentinel's Stop holds a second longer per rank.

nodes.name: Disarming Cut
nodes.desc: Learn the Disarming Cut: the foe's blows land lighter for 8 seconds.

nodes.name: Heavy Hand
nodes.desc: The Disarming Cut takes 3% more off the foe's blows per rank.

nodes.name: Iron Ring
nodes.desc: Learn the Iron Ring: every foe within 6 metres held where it stands for 3 seconds and slowed.

nodes.name: Held Ground
nodes.desc: The Iron Ring holds a second longer per rank.

nodes.name: Sentinel
nodes.desc: Your cuts on a held or slowed foe deal 5% more.

nodes.name: Patient Hilt
nodes.desc: Hilt Blow is ready a second sooner per rank.

nodes.name: Goading
nodes.desc: The Answering Cut turns the foe on you for 3 seconds.

nodes.name: The Iron Vow Kept
nodes.desc: The Iron Vow also holds every foe within 5 metres where it stands for 3 seconds.
